cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only caller and boundary compatibility across internal/infrastructure/web_fetch/..., internal/models/api/..., internal/models/rerank/..., internal/models/vlm/..., and whole-repo go vet -p 1 ./...: all exported signatures in web_search, modelcontext, models/api, models/chat, models/embedding, models/utils/ollama, and tracing/langfuse are preserved intact, and internal/models/parity TestCatalogMigrationBaseline passes unchanged.

invariants_checked: All 4 HTML extraction fixture files (article_with_chrome.html, cjk_article.html, doc_with_code.html, spa_hydration.html) are static offline HTML fixtures with valid UTF-8, zero live external credentials, zero host paths, and zero legacy brand residues.
Owned boundary respected: internal/infrastructure/web_fetch/*.go left untouched and verified green with -race.

SSRF and redirect defense-in-depth enforced across SearXNG, proxy, and custom HTTP search clients (DialContext IP validation via security.ValidateURLForSSRF, HTTP redirects disabled or re-validated per hop).

API keys, basic-auth userinfo, and secret query parameters are redacted from outbound request logs, proxy errors, and HTTP/transport error strings across Google, SearXNG, Serper, Tavily, Brave, Bocha, Metaso, Exa, Baidu, DeepSeek, Zhipu, and DuckDuckGo.

All 2xx JSON/HTML search response bodies are strictly bounded via readCapped/newCappedReadCloser (8 MiB max, rejecting oversized payloads) and non-2xx error bodies are bounded to 4 KiB UTF-8-safe previews.
Default User-Agent uses GENYEE-Bot/1.0 with zero legacy brand residues; concurrent SearXNG searches and EmptyResultDiagnostics are race-free under -race.

findings.summary: GoogleProvider passed both option.WithAPIKey and option.WithHTTPClient to customsearch.NewService, hitting google.golang.org/api/transport/http.NewClient's early HTTPClient return that silently dropped params.APIKey on every request, while following redirects, leaving response reads uncapped, and risking ?key= exposure in transport errors.

SearxngProvider read and wrote lastUnresponsive without synchronization (data race between concurrent Search and EmptyResultDiagnostics), and SearXNG/proxy URL handling could leak basic-auth userinfo or secret query parameters in request logs and transport/parse errors.

DuckDuckGoProvider.searchHTML parsed resp.Body directly via goquery without any response size cap, BaiduProvider and ExaProvider read unbounded non-2xx bodies via io.ReadAll while silently truncating oversized 2xx JSON via bare io.LimitReader, and Bocha/Metaso/DeepSeek/Zhipu error helpers formatted unbounded JSON error strings.

invariants_checked: Context-window token budget calculation, tool output packing, omitted-result summarization, and prompt evidence truncation preserve valid UTF-8 rune boundaries without mid-rune byte slicing.
Model context formatting is deterministic, bounded within configured token/character limits, and free of legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: ModelDocumentInfoOutput truncated UpdatedAt using raw byte slice updated[:10], splitting multi-byte UTF-8 date strings (such as localized CJK timestamps) mid-rune and emitting invalid UTF-8 XML attributes.

invariants_checked: Shared model HTTP transport enforces SSRF validation on remote custom BaseURLs, strips Authorization/API-Key/Cookie headers across cross-origin redirects, and bounds JSON/SSE response reads via ReadResponseCapped.

Endpoint.Resolve canonicalizes query parameters deterministically with URL escaping, and Endpoint.LogRequest/Do redact URL userinfo, secret query parameters, and outbound credential values from logs, TransportError, and HTTPError.
PlaceEmbeddings/ValidateEmbeddingVectors rejects NaN, +/-Inf, and intra-batch ragged vector dimensions before corrupting downstream vector indexes.
StreamPacketDumper synchronizes concurrent writes and Close() under mutex and restricts raw debug packet directories/files to owner-only permissions (0700/0600).

findings.summary: StreamPacketDumper read d.file outside d.mu in WriteRaw/WriteEvent and did not acquire d.mu in Close(), causing a data race on concurrent stream cancellation/close, and created raw LLM debug dump directories/files with world-readable 0755/0644 permissions.

Endpoint.Resolve iterated map keys in randomized order without url.QueryEscape, Endpoint.LogRequest logged raw URLs with embedded userinfo/query secrets, and Endpoint.Do leaked URL credentials or echoed auth tokens in TransportError/HTTPError while slicing error bodies at raw byte offset 512.

PlaceEmbeddings accepted NaN/+/-Inf float32 components and inconsistent intra-batch vector lengths without validation, allowing malformed provider responses to poison vector stores or panic downstream cosine similarity math.

invariants_checked: All 3 embedded catalog JSON datasets (models.generated.json, overrides.json, seed.json) parse cleanly as valid UTF-8 JSON with consistent provider/model schema fields.
Zero hardcoded secrets, zero host paths, and zero legacy brand residues across all catalog entries.

Chat and ChatStream implementations enforce SSRF checks on remote image URLs, reject non-2xx image responses, cap remote image downloads at 20 MiB without silent truncation, and guard nil Config/service pointers.

Streaming goroutines in OllamaChat, langfuseChat, and llmDebugChat exit promptly on ctx.Done() without deadlocking when callers stop draining the returned channel, while recording cancelled stream completion.
Langfuse generation input construction redacts base64 data: URIs across both top-level Images and MultiContent parts without mutating caller message slices.

findings.summary: OllamaChat.ChatStream blocked forever on unbuffered/undrained streamChan sends after context cancellation (leaking goroutines), NewChat/NewOllamaChat lacked nil config/service guards, and resolveImageForOllama base64-encoded non-2xx HTTP error pages as images while silently truncating >20 MiB payloads via bare io.LimitReader.

langfuseChat.ChatStream and llmDebugChat.ChatStream blocked on wrapped <- resp when callers cancelled ctx without draining wrapped (leaking goroutines and preventing gen.Finish from closing spans), and buildLangfuseMessages leaked raw multi-megabyte data: image URIs embedded in Message.MultiContent.

invariants_checked: Local Ollama and remote protocol embedders short-circuit empty batches cleanly without spurious network RPCs, enforce 1:1 output count parity, and validate non-empty finite (non-NaN/non-Inf) uniform-dimension vectors.
NilEmbedderPooler / nil OllamaService inputs fail closed or fall back safely without nil-pointer panics, and Embed error paths never format nil errors.

findings.summary: OllamaEmbedder and protocolEmbedder lacked nil service/pooler guards, OllamaEmbedder sent network RPCs on empty batches and formatted '%!w(<nil>)' when BatchEmbed returned zero vectors without error, and BatchEmbed/BatchEmbedImages accepted NaN/Inf, empty, or mismatched-dimension vectors.

invariants_checked: Catalog migration baseline hashes (TestCatalogMigrationBaseline) across resolved runtime configs, vendor endpoints, headers, and chat wire request bodies match testdata/catalog-baseline.json bit-for-bit.
Zero live external network calls, zero hardcoded credentials, zero host paths, and zero legacy brand residues across all parity tests and fixtures.

Localhost/127.0.0.1 Ollama connections work out-of-the-box without SSRF_WHITELIST while OLLAMA_BASE_URL enforces valid http/https scheme and non-empty host, blocks cross-origin POST redirect replay, strips credentials across redirects, and redacts userinfo/query secrets from logs and errors.
OllamaService.Generate verifies terminal Done=true completion on NDJSON streams so mid-stream upstream disconnects fail with io.ErrUnexpectedEOF rather than silently returning truncated output.

findings.summary: GetOllamaService accepted malformed or non-http(s) OLLAMA_BASE_URL values, logged raw URLs with embedded credentials, lacked cross-origin redirect guards on its custom HTTP client, lacked nil receiver/client guards in StartService, and OllamaService.Generate returned nil error on truncated streams that never emitted Done=true.

invariants_checked: Commercial Compliance Invariant preserved: Langfuse telemetry is strictly opt-in / disabled by default (Enabled=false unless explicit host + credentials/flag are configured, never selecting an implicit cloud host and spawning zero background goroutines or outbound HTTP calls when disabled).

BatchSpanProcessor queue and flush sizes are normalized and capped (QueueSize <= 65536, FlushAt <= 4096 and <= QueueSize), Config.Validate enforces http(s) Host and SampleRate in [0, 1], and replacing an active singleton in Init cleanly shuts down the prior BatchSpanProcessor.

Secrets, basic-auth userinfo, Bearer tokens, API keys, and sensitive query/JSON fields are redacted across manager startup logs/errors, GinMiddleware http.query metadata, Span/Generation Finish error events/statuses, and Asynq payload previews.

Trace/Span metadata maps are cloned on open and Finish is idempotent via atomic.Bool (race-free under -race); Asynq 1 KiB payload previews truncate on valid UTF-8 rune boundaries; retrieval observability summaries handle nil slice elements and NaN scores without panicking.

findings.summary: Config.Validate accepted non-http(s)/malformed Host URLs and out-of-range/NaN SampleRate values, LoadConfigFromEnv/Init left QueueSize/FlushAt uncapped or unnormalized on programmatic Init, and Init leaked the previous manager's BatchSpanProcessor goroutine on re-initialization while logging unredacted Host URLs.

GinMiddleware exported raw c.Request.URL.RawQuery (leaking api_key/access_token/password query params), Span.Finish and Generation.Finish recorded unredacted credentials/API keys in OTel error events and status descriptions, and StartTrace/StartSpan retained caller metadata map references without cloning or guarding concurrent Finish calls.

spanInputFromPayload sliced raw payload[:1024] bytes (splitting multi-byte UTF-8 runes mid-character) and echoed raw JSON credentials in task previews, while SummarizeRetrieveOutput, SummarizeSearchResults, and SummarizePassagePreviews panicked on nil slice elements or violated sort.Slice strict weak ordering on NaN scores.
